# Security reporting

The current Orvaket `main` branch is the only supported version of this early-access prototype after the Orvaket deployment. Older downloaded copies and previous deployments remain available for data migration, but are not maintained as supported releases.

Please report a software vulnerability through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Akam1123/orvaket/security/advisories/new). Include reproduction steps, the affected URL or commit, and the potential impact. Do not include real customer records, invoice files, passwords, payment details, or secrets in a report. Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue before it can be investigated.

GitHub private vulnerability reporting is for software security findings. This project does not yet publish a verified private channel for customer support or privacy rights requests. The current [privacy notice](../public/privacy/index.html) explains the data flow and its limitations. No response time or complete protection against vulnerabilities is promised.
